autopay_cancel.note: To cancel Automatic Payment, call Insurance Service before the next payment is processed: 800-922-8228 (CA), 888-222-0094 (DE, DC, MD, NJ, PA, VA) or 800-207-3618 (all other states).

help.title: How do I make a payment?
paragraphs: Without signing in, make a secure one-time payment with your policy number and your billing ZIP code.

In MyPolicy, choose Make a payment on the Home screen, find the policy on the Bills screen, confirm or edit the amount (minimum due, full amount or another amount), choose a payment method, review and select Pay. A confirmation is emailed if we have your email address.
It can take up to 48 business hours for your policy to show the payment.
steps: Select Make a payment on the Home screen.
Find the policy on the Bills screen and select Make a payment.
Choose a payment method and select Continue.

help.title: Set up AutoPay
paragraphs: From Bills and payments, open AutoPay settings, find the policy and select Set up AutoPay. Pay automatically from a checking or savings account or a debit or credit card.

Automatic Payment charges your saved method on or shortly after each due date for the amount you owe, including installment and returned-payment fees. If your regular amount changes you are told at least 10 days before the charge.

To cancel Automatic Payment, call Insurance Service before the payment is processed: 800-922-8228 in California, 888-222-0094 in Delaware, DC, Maryland, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Virginia, or 800-207-3618 elsewhere.

help.title: Paperless preferences
paragraphs: Choose Communication preferences in the main menu and turn on email notifications for all policies, or switch each policy from Paperless is off to Paperless is on, then Save.

You get an email when a bill or document is ready and a payment reminder three days before the due date. Bills come either by email notification or by mail, not both. Up to two years of bills and documents stay in MyPolicy.

help.title: What you can do in MyPolicy
paragraphs: Print or view proof of insurance, set up and manage automatic payments or make one-time payments, add or remove drivers and vehicles on eligible auto policies, and open your policy documents.
Have your policy number and AAA membership number ready to create your account. Changes to property policies and address changes are made by phone with Insurance Service, 24/7, at 888-980-5650.
